cand.title: 10th International Workshop on Grapevine Downy and Powdery Mildews
cand.excerpt: Possible incremental Hotel Market if independently bookable demand is evidenced.
cand.recoveryAsk: HIGH deep research: verify dates, lodging mechanism, named lodging/meetings contact, YOTEL fit, competitor commitment.
cand.selectionWhy: 34-candidate commercial-quality queue · priority 1 · CORE_OR_NEAR · contact MISSING

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named lodging/meeting buyer or person with GDPM 2027 procurement authority was verified. Two named referral candidates are documented: Katia Gindro, Agroscope Mycology Group head, for an institutional scientific-team referral; Johann Marmy, Agroscope communications specialist, whose name appears in the official event image credit, for a communications referral only. Neither is verified as a 2027 organizer, accommodation manager or contracting decision-maker. The official event mailbox remains the strongest event-specific route.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming tenth edition: 13–16 July 2027, inside the requested horizon. These are activity dates, not the 5 October 2026 announcement date. Official English and French Agroscope announcements agree. No later edition was identified in the reviewed official materials.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: a geographically plausible lodging/satellite opportunity for YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex, in the same La Côte territory as the Nyon venue. The scientific meeting is already assigned to Changins, so do not pitch relocation of the main workshop. The official travel guidance says, “Geneva International Airport (GVA) is located 25 km from Nyon, with direct trains to Nyon.” This supports airport access to Nyon, not a hotel shuttle or a convenient final leg from YOTEL; that transfer must be checked. This is not a central-Geneva mega-convention or a resort-led programme. A limited room block could be explored only after demand and lodging freedom are confirmed; 20–120 rooms is the supplied sales guardrail, not published event demand. Six meeting rooms might support an optional small ancillary meeting only if requested. Do not assume banquet/catering capacity, whole-house demand or that the event is too small/large without a 2027 count.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. Territory: Nyon / La Côte, not central Geneva, Lausanne or French Pays de Gex. The organizer has announced its own research-site venue; this is a published commitment, not evidence that a venue contract was inspected. It is not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: The official 2022 announcement lists Geneva, New York (1991), Freiburg (1994), Loxton (1998), Napa (2002), San Michele (2005), Bordeaux (2009), Vitoria-Gasteiz (2013), Corvallis (2017), followed by Cremona on 20–22 July 2022. Geneva in the 1991 history is Geneva, New York, USA, not Geneva, Switzerland. The 2027 site describes meetings every three to four years since 1991; the published 2022-to-2027 interval is five years. Treat this as a recurrent internationally rotating workshop, not an annual or permanently Nyon-based event.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific evidence of pre-reserved rooms: the official site states, “Deadline for booking pre-reserved hotel rooms: 31 March 2027.” It also says, “Fees, payment and accommodation details are available on the Practical Information page.” That linked page could not be retrieved. Therefore pre-reservation arrangements exist, but every hotel name, block quantity, rate, release terms, booking channel and remaining availability are unresolved. No edition-specific hotel names could be verified. A housing bureau, exclusive host hotel, independent direct-booking route or open RFP was not established. General event inquiry: info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Do not equate the future booking deadline with open supplier sourcing.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is the documented organizer and research-site host. Its official organization page says it is attached to the Swiss Federal Office for Agriculture; this is a federal research institution, not a membership association or hotel/PCO. The international workshop is the programme; Agroscope is the organizer. The event site says Agroscope and the City of Nyon look forward to welcoming participants, but that does not establish the city as buyer or accommodation contractor. No separate PCO, DMC or housing bureau was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The published pre-reserved-room deadline is evidence of an existing accommodation arrangement, hence a real incumbent obstacle even though properties and exclusivity remain unknown. No hotel can responsibly be named as an incumbent from accessible edition-specific evidence. No sold-out, overflow, displacement or unmet room demand was found. The 2022 statement of more than 50 enrolled is historical registration information, not a 2027 room or attendance forecast.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch now, ahead of the published 31 March 2027 hotel-booking deadline. Request the named accommodation coordinator and the practical-information document; ask for every reserved hotel, room allocations, exclusivity, direct-booking rules, unmet demand, arrival/departure nights and transfer requirements. Only if supplier access is confirmed, offer a modest supplementary Founex allocation with a costed Changins transfer plan; avoid an unsolicited 120-room or whole-house commitment. Ask Katia Gindro for a local organizing-team referral if the event mailbox does not resolve ownership; use Johann Marmy only as a secondary communications referral. Keep qualification and publication with ORS pending these answers.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The relevant current sales cycle is the upcoming July 2027 edition. Venue access is closed for the announced main workshop in the sense that Changins is already selected; accommodation supplier access is unconfirmed, not proven closed or open. Participant registration is advertised and pre-reserved hotel booking has a 31 March 2027 deadline. Neither establishes a route for YOTEL to sell independently or join the arrangements.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: first seek permission to supplement the 2027 accommodation arrangements; this is distinct from bidding for a later workshop. International historical rotation weakens any assumption of repeat Nyon demand. No next-edition date, city or venue is verified, so do not create a future Nyon edition or forecast an annual room block. Broader Agroscope workshop relationships could be developed, but no additional dated demand is established here.
